name: io.github.originallgb/veristat
description: Independent multi-model verification: fans a claim, plan, or draft to a cross-vendor panel of frontier models (Anthropic + OpenAI + Google) and returns a structured consensus verdict — agreements, contradictions, dissent, calibrated confidence. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base); no vendor accounts needed. Free get_sample_verdict tool to inspect output before paying.
